window.note: identical across datasets; window size chosen by occupancy + task-filtered feasibility

unsw.normalisation: training-only gmean/gstd recomputed per replicate; categorical universe and host padding fixed to full-train values

ton.resampling: within each class's own contiguous training sequence; classes never concatenated or shared
ton.note: primary block chosen as operational compromise (30 min) keeping >=6 bootstrap blocks for every primary class

ton.estimand: per-class contiguous chronological (60 s aligned per class, benign window-matched)

rationale: bootstrap block length follows dataset-specific temporal dependence (ACF); UNSW global split -> coarse blocks from fine ACF; ToN per-class sequences -> within-class bootstrap blocks; hence different block configs
